next.reason: 1985: a report file is specified only once in FILE-CONTROL and its SELECT needs an FD with a REPORT clause in the same program. 2023: 'A given file-name may be specified in only one SELECT clause' (§2023:12.4.5.2 SR2); each SELECT needs an FD or SD in the same source element (§2023:12.4.5.2 SR3), and Format 3 (report) is used only with an FD, not an SD (§2023:12.4.5.2 SR11); each FD's file-name 'shall be specified in a file control entry' (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR1); 'Format 3 is the file description entry for a report file' (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR8) and its format (§2023:13.4.5.2) requires REPORT IS/REPORTS ARE. All compile-time; same programs refused.
